checks.name: parameter_layout
checks.evidence: ReferenceStudy.swift:411-435 documents and builds six SIMD4<Float> rows: relative camera origin/halfW, forward/halfH, right/radius, up/panel extent, color-transform parameters, sample count/area count/minimum depth/grid. Counts derive from triplet-array lengths. The interactive grid is consistently 8.

checks.name: sample_and_area_layout
checks.evidence: ReferenceStudy.swift:236-265 creates active-light samples only; point and directional sources get one sample each, rectangles get 64 samples sharing a zero-based area index and candela/64. Lines 272-282 pack position/candela, emission-normal/enabled, XYZ/one-based-area-index and three area rows carrying center/minimum-distance, right/halfWidth, up/halfHeight. Non-area color.w is zero.
checks.test_evidence: StudyComputeInputTests.swift:6-27 covers one rectangle, one directional source, one inactive light, summed rectangle candela and area scalar payloads. Tests not run.

checks.name: relative_coordinates
checks.evidence: ReferenceStudy.swift:274,281,425-432 subtracts the same subject center from sample positions, rectangle centers and camera origin before Float conversion; basis directions, dimensions and spectral values remain untranslated.
checks.test_evidence: StudyComputeInputTests.swift:30-38 compares parameter/sample arrays after a common (20,10,-13) translation. That test does not compare areas and uses the portrait fixture without explicitly adding a rectangle. Tests not run.

checks.name: finite_conversion_preconditions
checks.evidence: ReferenceStudy.swift:233 calls scene.validated before creating samples; camera/geometry and color-transform construction must succeed in StudySetup. The final pack helper at lines 548-549 performs ordinary Float conversion without an additional isFinite guard. The inspected default mixed-light test asserts all packed components finite. No concrete overflow/nonfinite input passing all upstream validators was established.
checks.limitation: Definitions of LightingScene.validated, CameraFraming, PreviewColorTransform.computeParameters and PreviewColorimetry.blackbody were outside this narrow source scope, so global finite-output safety across all validated boundary values was not independently proved.

checks.name: input_error_ordering
checks.evidence: StudySetup lines 447-458 checks width range and divisibility first, then camera/geometry/clearance, then constructs StudyLighting (scene validation before emitter generation), then the display transform. StudyComputeInput and the CPU renderer share StudySetup. Width validation occurs before height arithmetic and packed-array construction.
checks.test_evidence: StudyComputeInputTests.swift:57-65 covers empty lights, width 193 rejection, and camera equal to subject producing invalidCamera. It does not assert compound-invalid-input error precedence. Tests not run.
